highlights.zh: 相册新增 YuNet + SFace CPU 人脸识别，普通双核 CPU 也能运行。
highlights.en: Added YuNet + SFace face recognition on CPU, suitable for machines without a dedicated GPU.

highlights.zh: 人脸识别队列持久化保存，全系统同一时间只运行一个任务，支持开始、暂停、停止并清空，重启后可继续处理。
highlights.en: Added a persistent, system-wide single-task face queue with start, pause, stop and clear controls, plus resume support after restart.

highlights.zh: 可自动将新增图片加入识别队列并自动去重，人脸识别设置仅系统管理员可见。
highlights.en: New images can join the face queue automatically with deduplication; face recognition settings are restricted to system administrators.

highlights.zh: 人脸数据支持一张图片对应多个人脸，方便后续按人物整理和检索。
highlights.en: Face data now supports multiple people in one image, laying the foundation for future people-based organization and search.

highlights.zh: 文件索引新增“补全缺少信息”，只处理缺少修改时间、拍摄时间或拍摄地点的记录，无信息的字段会写入标记，避免重复读取。
highlights.en: Added “Fill Missing Information” for index records lacking modification time, capture time, or location; empty values are marked to avoid repeated reads.

highlights.zh: 系统启动时检查全部仓库数据库版本，自动执行可靠迁移；迁移失败会回滚并停止启动，且不会在启动时扫描文件。
highlights.en: Startup now checks every repository database and runs reliable migrations; failed migrations roll back and stop startup, with no startup file scans.

highlights.zh: 首页新增更新日志入口，管理员打开首页时可自动查看新版主要改动，关闭后同版本不再提醒。
highlights.en: Added a Home changelog entry; administrators can automatically see new release highlights, with no repeated reminder after closing that version.

rebuild_index_notice.zh: 历史图片不会在系统启动时自动扫描或识别人脸。需要人脸结果时，请在相册设置点击“开始识别”；索引缺少媒体信息时，请使用“补全缺少信息”，无需为了数据库迁移重建全量索引。
rebuild_index_notice.en: Existing images are not scanned or face-indexed automatically at startup. Use “Start Recognition” in Album Settings for face results and “Fill Missing Information” for incomplete media metadata; database migration does not require a full index rebuild.

highlights.zh: 相册新增文件名和文件大小排序、字母标尺，并可隐藏标尺侧边栏。
highlights.en: Added filename and file-size sorting, an alphabet ruler, and an optional ruler sidebar to the album.

highlights.zh: 相册支持时间轴、图片/视频筛选、批量选择、媒体预览和详情侧边栏。
highlights.en: Added album timelines, image/video filters, batch selection, media previews, and a details sidebar.

highlights.zh: 文件索引新增修改时间、拍摄时间和拍摄地点，媒体详情可直接查看。
highlights.en: File indexes now include modification time, capture time, and location for display in media details.

highlights.zh: 新增系统管理员、仓库管理员和仓库成员权限，成员仅可浏览相册。
highlights.en: Added system administrator, repository administrator, and member roles; members can only browse albums.

highlights.zh: 首页和登录页支持亮色/暗色主题及中英文切换，接口提示随全站语言变化。
highlights.en: Added light/dark themes and Chinese/English switching on Home and Login, with matching API messages.

highlights.zh: 相册缩略图分辨率可配置，文件仓库与相册统一使用按需生成接口。
highlights.en: Added configurable album thumbnail resolution and a shared on-demand thumbnail endpoint.

highlights.zh: 系统新增时区设置和日志自动清理，可按保留天数清理过期日志。
highlights.en: Added system timezone settings and automatic log cleanup based on a configurable retention period.

rebuild_index_notice.zh: 历史图片/视频需要重新建立索引，才能补全修改时间、拍摄时间和拍摄地点；也可以使用“补全缺少信息”只处理索引中缺失的记录。
rebuild_index_notice.en: Rebuild the index for existing images/videos to populate modification time, capture time, and location, or use “Fill Missing Information” to process only incomplete index records.
